origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay spends its tokens on reasoning (reasoning_content) and runs out of them before any text or call (finish_reason length). Codex names no output limit, so the limit is the gateway's own default (4096 tokens): the answer has nothing to show, and told as incomplete it would be asked for five more times, each paid for. It is an interruption (a 502 that is not charged), the relay is kept from the session, and the client's retry reaches another source that is not held to the default. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
